title: MQM-P plans rally in Karachi for new administrative units
seoTitle: Karachi MQM-P rally for new province

tea.why: The party is advocating for the creation of new administrative units and a new province representing urban Sindh.
tea.want: The party seeks official permission to hold a rally and public gathering to demonstrate support for their administrative proposals.
tea.changed: Nov 25: The Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) requested that the MQM-P postpone their planned November 29 event to prevent potential clashes.

summary: The Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan (MQM-P) has formally requested permission from the Karachi commissioner to hold a rally and public gathering on November 29. The planned event is intended to garner public support for the establishment of new administrative units and a new province for urban Sindh. According to reports, the party plans to march along Shahrah-e-Faisal before convening at Bagh-e-Jinnah. The MQM-P has requested security and administrative assistance from the city government to ensure the event proceeds as planned. Meanwhile, the Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) has engaged in discussions with the MQM-P and other nationalist groups, urging them to delay their demonstrations to avoid potential conflict.
demands: Creation of a new province for urban Sindh
response: The Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) has held meetings with the MQM-P and other groups, requesting that they postpone their November 29 rallies to avoid potential clashes.

updates.text: The MQM-P submitted a formal application to the Karachi commissioner for a rally and public gathering on November 29.
The Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) urged the MQM-P to postpone the planned November 29 event to avoid potential clashes.
